name: agentmesh-mobile
description: AgentMesh native Android shell: workflow viewer/controller and background geofence trigger client.

scripts.build:web: cross-env MOBILE_BUILD=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_NATIVE_CLIENT=1 npm --prefix ../frontend run build
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && cap sync android
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && cap run android
